area: tooling docs: the Unity CLI rules (CLAUDE.md, Docs/unity-cli-setup.md)
summary: Added a rule: never run eval in a loop against the open editor, and never switch the Profiler on from an eval in Play.
why: Measured 2026-11-26: each eval freezes the editor 1.2-1.6 s with 114 MB of garbage; a test script polling every 2 s was the freeze Yash saw every few seconds in the menu. The Profiler switched on from an eval ended the editor.
